checks.name: cancellation Preview is exact isolated DEV with external payment disabled
only the selected unstarted order offers cancellation; the paid initial order remains protected
a separate customer cannot view or cancel the target through either case identifier
response loss after actual successful HTTP cancellation is presented as unconfirmed
retry uses the same order, receives confirmation and refreshes stored history
reload preserves the cancelled order and sends neither checkout nor refund requests

scope: Owned synthetic quote/order/payment/readiness and seeded customer sessions. Actual hosted UI/HTTP/DEV cancellation, lost response/retry/reload. No live quote basis, provider checkout/refund, financial correctness or production.
